# `repos`

Run repos with no arguments to pick a repo (then a worktree, if any) with fzf
and print its path. The shell hook (repos init) wraps that in an r function
which cds into the picked dir.

Layout:
  <repos-dir>/<git-host-domain>/<repo-owner>/<repo-name>[.git]
  Bare and non-bare repos are detected by content, so owner subgroups
  (e.g. gitlab.com/group/subgroup/repo) are supported at any depth.

Env:
  REPOS_DIR   Directory containing repositories in URL format (default: $HOME/repos).
  REPOS_BARE  Default for clone/create: 1/true clones bare with a .git suffix,
              0/false clones with a work tree. Default: 1. Flags override.
  REPOS_TYPESAFE_API_KEY  TypeSafe API key (JEV_KEY also works). Enables
              repos launch; without it the r picker stays fully offline.
  JEV_CONFIDENCE  Minimum calibrated confidence (0-1) before launch jumps
              without asking (default: 0.5).

Launch:
  The rl shell hook (installed by repos init) uses repos launch to resolve a
  plain-language description to one repo via Jev. On a weak or missing match
  it falls back to r. Only repo metadata is sent, never file contents.

Worktrees:
  repos lists worktrees of the picked repository and offers them, so r can hop
  straight into one. Create new worktrees with worktrunk: run wt switch <branch>
  inside a bare repo.


## Examples

**Hop into a repo**

Pick a repo (then a worktree) with fzf and cd into it

```
r
```

**Hop by description**

Jump to the repo matching a description via Jev (needs a key)

```
rl "the one that handles the auth group sync"
```

**Clone shorthand**

Clone into the layout via ssh, bare by default

```
repos clone markazos/markazos
```

**Create a repo**

Init a new bare repo under your owner

```
repos create thisisibrahimd/my-new-repo
```

- **Usage:** `repos [SUBCOMMAND]`

## `repos clone`

- **Usage:** `repos clone [--bare] [--no-bare] <src>`

Clone into the layout, print the path

### Arguments
- **`<src>`** — <https-url> | <ssh-url> | [host/]owner/repo

### Flags
- **`--bare`** — Force a bare repository (default), name suffixed with .git
- **`--no-bare`** — Force a repository with a work tree, no suffix

## `repos create`

- **Usage:** `repos create [--bare] [--no-bare] <owner/repo>`

Init a new repo into the layout, print the path

### Arguments
- **`<owner/repo>`** — New repo path under your owner

### Flags
- **`--bare`** — Force a bare repository (default), name suffixed with .git
- **`--no-bare`** — Force a repository with a work tree, no suffix

## `repos launch`

- **Usage:** `repos launch <desc>`

Print the repo matching a description via Jev, or nothing

### Arguments
- **`<desc>`** — Plain-language description of the work to find

## `repos init`

- **Usage:** `repos init [shell]`

Print shell hook

### Arguments
- **`[shell]`** — Shell to emit the hook for

  **Default:** `bash`
